messages.speaker: Maya Chen
messages.text: Can we please stop losing the admin settings thread every week lol. Customers keep asking where SAML config lives.

messages.speaker: Leo Park
messages.text: SAML is not the hard part. The annoying part is where we put all the org-level stuff. Billing has one page, user roles have another, audit logs are buried.

messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: Small tangent but the coffee machine on 3F is broken again. I filed a ticket.

messages.speaker: Sarah Kim
messages.text: From the sales side, enterprise admins expect one place called something like Organization Settings. When we show separate pages during demos, it looks unfinished.

messages.speaker: Owen Diaz
messages.text: Could also just rename the existing billing settings page and shove SAML there for now. Not beautiful but cheaper.

messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: Please don't put SAML under billing. We'll regret that in like two weeks. I'd rather create a real Organization Settings section and move billing, roles, audit logs, and SAML under it.

messages.speaker: Leo Park
messages.text: That is more work, but it matches where the product is going. Billing-only shortcut saves maybe 3 days and creates another cleanup project.

messages.speaker: Maya Chen
messages.text: My only worry is slipping the admin beta. We promised it to design partners before 2026-08-05.

messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: If we keep the first pass boring, I can have the new section wired by next Friday. No custom permissions redesign, just navigation plus moving the existing pages.

messages.speaker: Sarah Kim
messages.text: That would solve the demo issue. Also lol at 'first pass boring' — honestly that's all we need.

messages.speaker: Owen Diaz
messages.text: Works for me. Priya, can you take the nav work? I can move audit logs once the route exists.

messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: Yep. I'll make Organization Settings the parent section, move billing and roles first, then SAML. Audit logs can follow after Owen's piece.

messages.speaker: Maya Chen
messages.text: Ok then let's keep permissions redesign out of scope. I want something design partners can use before the Aug 5 beta, not a whole IA rebuild.

messages.speaker: Leo Park
messages.text: Agree. Tradeoff is we accept a basic IA now instead of doing the full permissions model. Safer than hiding SAML under billing.

messages.speaker: Sarah Kim
messages.text: Unrelated but are we still doing the customer call at 2? I have a conflict.
